answer: The defense is a bonded identity register with cross-ledger correlation. An agent posts a stake and completes a task derived from its own prior history, so each identity carries a distinct, costly record. A watcher scans for overlap: if two accounts share a task batch or funding path, both stakes are slashed. Cloning multiplies capital cost while rewards stay flat, pushing a farm to its nadir within a few clones. Faking many agents means crossing the same river of capital per identity, and one reuse burns the grove. Identity is priced by irreversible work, so fakery is a net loss.
